limits: Owner-supplied research, not independent verification. Verification labels inside the upload are the compiler's claims only; all imported facts remain pending review.
Identifier-only entries are not complete specification records. Combined parts/fitment references stay intact and are never split into invented watch SKUs.
Blank CSV fields mean unknown, not zero or absent. Partial release years/months retain their precision and market qualifications.
Model-to-module associations are separate from module functions. A shared module does not establish an individual variant's case, band, weight or display.
Source keys and cited URLs are preserved as supplied; underlying documents named in the register are not assumed received or independently checked.
Stopwatch maximum display in seconds is a capacity, not a measurement-accuracy claim. Reception limits distinguish China and stop after success where stated.
All existing catalog values are retained. Differing supplied candidates are shown in the research comparison list, not used to silently replace earlier facts.

report_notes.text: GAC-2500 resin: 46.7 × 44.5 × 12.7 mm / 47 g. GMC-2500 resin strap: 46.7 × 43.8 × 12.9 mm / 68 g; GMC-2500D bracelet: 138 g. Case and mass profiles are not interchangeable.
GWF-D1000BC-1 is reported at 181 g with composite bracelet; do not reuse the 141 g resin-band Frogman weight.

The report cites the regional GW-9503KJ-2JR Japan listing for 2026-11, 88 g and 56.7 × 52.7 × 14.8 mm. CSV uses GW-9503KJ-2. Other editions do not automatically inherit this mass; the regional suffix association remains supplied research.
Modules 3260 / 3280 share a guide but can differ in LCD polarity. GW-9300 variant assignments to 3260 are provisional pending exact case-back checks.
Module 3445 maximum stopwatch display is reported as 99:59:59.99 (359999.99 seconds); module 3410 as 999:59:59.99 (3599999.99 seconds).
All numeric stopwatch and timer capacities are seconds. Missing values remain unknown. An empty automatic-attempt count does not mean automatic calibration is absent.
